Login initialization and first-prompt cancellation callbacks have different boundaries; no all-throws-clean-up guarantee is made.",
        "Current MessageSend defers the onStopCopy listener callback, catches XPConnect failures and calls _cleanup afterwards. Its comment explains the compose-window/send-object/promise lifetime reason for deferral; that race was not exercised.
